study: Single-person R4 support-conditioned pairwise temporal readout, generic development only.
subject: sub-04
scope: Use exactly the historical 416 training and 96 held development objects of sub-04. Evaluate previously used same-recording-session 12/4 alternatives with two query photos per object per fold and eight supports. No new personal12 inputs or trial scores. Previously known mixed 514 of 960 twelve-way and 689 of 960 four-way. Earlier hard-pair readout and global 96D cosine prototypes motivated testing every candidate pair with local EEG and support-conditioned time weights.
data: 4 recorded trials, original 63 channels and [0,.5)s. Mean raw EEG within 20-ms bins; group into five consecutive 100-ms windows with 315 coordinates (63 x 5 bins). Within each 100-ms token, one shared affine projection 315->48, GELU, per-vector L2 normalization. Input standardization uses training EEG only. A trial view averages two physical preprocessed trials before projection. Train cyclically on the three possible complementary bipartitions; at evaluation average their final class scores. All inference inputs belong to one person.
baseline: Freeze the exact individual 50:50 standardized Fisher96 plus four-trial encoder96 menu score. For training the new conditional classifier, generate one out-of-fold Fisher/old-trial score from a classifier trained on 312 objects for each of four fixed 104-object inner folds (permutation 260564, shared with the earlier pose feature protocol). Refit/restore original full 416 backbone only for evaluation. Choose training menus entirely within one held inner fold and the focal recording-session pair, so every baseline margin in a training episode is out of sample at the object level. Teacher features only EEG, recomputed freshly from generic-only sources. No validation data used to choose gains, time windows or checkpoints.
matcher: For each candidate average the eight support photographs within each time band and each complementary trial view. For an ordered candidate pair A,B compute the query margin for the signed distance between its centers, cross-comparing complementary views. The per-band class utility is (q0 dot m1 + q1 dot m0 - m0 dot m1)/2; the pair margin is its A minus B. An eight-hidden-unit SiLU gate plus five learned static time biases softmaxes over the five windows. The gate sees three symmetric inputs per pair/window: cross-view agreement of A minus B separation directions, mean within-class support cross-view scatter for the two objects, and absolute difference of query margins between the two complementary views. Aggregate signed pair margins over all other candidates, standardize scores per menu, and add a trainable common scalar in (0,1) initialized .2 times this residual to the frozen baseline scores.
controls: Train two new heads with identical model size, seed, episodes, subject and optimizer. The matched head gives each candidate pair its own temporal gate. The pooled-pair control averages the three gate inputs over all distinct candidate pairs for that query and time window before applying the identical gate; it retains the same learned projection, pairwise margin, number of parameters and training budget. Report reference-only scores and the historical other-query control which replaces the whole EEG input, plus conditioned wrong-query decisions with unchanged menu and support. Main comparison uses the full registered candidate sets, not a top-two reranker.
training: 750 updates with seed 260569, one randomized 12-class episode of 120 photos per step (each of the five support folds used for all 120 object decisions), cyclically alternate the 4 inner folds and each own session pair. AdamW learning rate .001, cosine decay, weight decay .02, gradient norm cap 5, fixed CE temperature 2 on logits. No seed search, validation tuning, causal or population claim. CPU precompute generic tokens/Fisher arrays. Use one GPU serially.
gate: 10,000 whole-object paired bootstrap draws across the 96 objects, fixed seed 260552. Advance past this study only if in twelve-way recognition both matched-minus-original and matched-minus-pooled-gate lower 95% bounds exceed zero, four-way matched total is at least original, and matched beats exchanged EEG in twelve-way trials. Record negative outcomes and stop before personal12. A passed generic screen would justify separate frozen-person validation before any images.
